openapi_airbnb_post_excerpt:
/channels/airbnb:
      post:
        summary: Alpha - Perform actions at Airbnb
        tags:
          - Channels - Airbnb
        security:
          - token: []
          - organization: []
        requestBody:
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    airbnbUserId: 
                      type: string
                      nullable: true
                    airbnbListingId: 
                      type: string
                    roomId:
                      type: string
                    propertyId:
                      type: string
                    action: 
                        type: string
                        enum:
                          - "importAsNewProperty"
                          - "importToExistingProperty"
                          - "connectToExistingRoom"
                          - "disconnectRoom"
                    connect:
                      type: string
                      enum:
                        - "none"
                        - "inventory"
                        - "limited"
                        - "full"
                    importBlockedDates:
                      type: boolean
                    importBookings:
                      type: boolean
              examples:
                importAsNewProperty:
                  summary: Import an Airbnb listing as a new property
                  value: [
                          {
                            "action": "importAsNewProperty",
                            "airbnbUserId": "123456",
                            "airbnbListingId": "789012",
                            "connect": "full"
                          }
                        ]
                importAsNewPropertyBlockedDates:
                  summary: Import an Airbnb listing and blocked dates
                  value: [
                          {
                            "action": "importAsNewProperty",
                            "airbnbUserId": "123456",
                            "airbnbListingId": "789012",
                            "connect": "full",
                            "importBlockedDates": true
                          }
                        ]
                importAsNewPropertyBookings:
                  summary: Import an Airbnb listing and bookings
                  value: [
                          {
                            "action": "importAsNewProperty",
                            "airbnbUserId": "123456",
                            "airbnbListingId": "789012",
                            "connect": "full",
                            "importBlockedDates": true,
                            "importBookings": true
                          }
                        ]
                importToExistingProperty:
                  summary: Import an Airbnb listing to an existing property
                  value: [
                          {
                          "action": "importToExistingProperty",
                          "airbnbUserId": "123456",
                          "airbnbListingId": "789012",
                          "connect": "full",
                          "propertyId": 3456789
                         }
                        ]
                connectToExistingRoom:
                  summary: Connect an Airbnb listing to an existing room
                  value: [
                          {
                          "action": "connectToExistingRoom",
                          "airbnbUserId": "123456",
                          "airbnbListingId": "789012",
                          "connect": "full",
                          "roomId": 3456789
                         }
                        ]
                disconnectRoom:
                  summary: Disconnect a room from Airbnb
                  value: [
                          {
                            "action": "disconnectRoom",
                            "roomId": 12345
                          }
                        ]
        responses:
          '201':
            description: Successful operation
            headers:
              X-FiveMinCreditLimit:
                $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit'
              X-FiveMinCreditLimit-ResetsIn:
                $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit-ResetsIn'
              X-FiveMinCreditLimit-Remaining:
                $ref: '#/components/headers/X-FiveMinCreditLimit-Remaining'
              X-RequestCost:
                $ref: '#/components/headers/X-RequestCost'
            content:
              application/json:
                schema:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    allOf:
                      - type: object
                      - $ref: '#/components/schemas/multiplePostResponse'
